# Round 2 onboarding clarifications

The following items were held or tagged conservatively where the source data did not support a definitive resolution. No advisor, household relationship, fee percentage, or status was inferred beyond the stated source information and the Round 1 guidance.

items.trigger: Four households have no primary advisor in the Advisor field. Service Rep values are not being treated as advisors, consistent with Round 1 guidance. Whitfield points to A. Novak, and Delgado has an interaction attended by A. Novak; Dana identified A. Novak as Anna Novak, a former contractor whose clients need reassignment.
items.evidence: Delgado: Maria Delgado; Service Rep Marcus Webb; account CU-5004 at Schwab, $1,240,000, as of 2024-12-31. Petit: Louis Petit; Service Rep Marcus Webb; account CU-6020 at Schwab, $540,000, as of 2025-06-30. Vandermeer: Joris Vandermeer; no Service Rep; account CU-6021 at Pershing, $1,620,000, as of 2025-06-30. Whitfield: George Whitfield; Service Rep A. Novak; account CU-5005 at Pershing, $670,000, as of 2025-06-30. Source evidence for Whitfield says: "Another **Harborline** client. Anna was looking after him before she left the firm — needs reassigning to someone current." The four households, their accounts, and related meetings were held out pending confirmation.
candidate_options: Option A — Dana assigns the current primary advisor for each household, including the replacement for any household still pointing to A. Novak; release the held households after confirmation.
Option B — Leave all four households unassigned and continue holding their accounts and related meetings out until advisor assignments are provided.
Option C — Use the listed Service Rep as the primary advisor temporarily.
